# Test fixtures

`alice.mobi` and `alice.azw3` are copied from the
[`ebook-rs`](https://github.com/SV-stark/ebook-rs) sample corpus:

- `Alice in Wonderland - Lewis Carroll.mobi`
- `Alice in Wonderland - Lewis Carroll.azw3`

They are used only to verify MOBI/KF6 and AZW3/KF8 parsing, TOC, cover and image
extraction. See the upstream repository for the sample licensing/attribution.
